sentences.text:
Sri. Sara Ramaiah vs The State Of Telangana on 13 September,
2024
 The Hon'Ble Sri Justice C. V. Bhaskar Reddy
 Writ Petition No.25461 of 2024

entities.text: Sara Ramaiah vs The State Of Telangana
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
Order:
This Writ Petition is filed praying this Court to declare the action of respondent Nos.3 and 4 in
interfering and trying to lay the road through the land admeasuring Ac.2.22 guntas in
Sy.No.238/UU/3 o

f petitioner No.1 and Ac.2.22 guntas in Sy.No.238/UU/2 of petitioner No.2, total admeasuring Ac.5.04 guntas situated at Medikunda Village, Wattipally Mandal, Sangareddy District, without acquiring the same as illegal, arbitrary and in violation of the principles of natural justice and contrary to the procedure as contemplated under the provisions of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency and Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 (for short "the Act, 2013) and consequently prayed to direct respondent Nos.3 and 4 not to interfered with the peaceful possession of the petitioners over the subject property.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency and Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 2. It is stated that the petitioner Nos.1 and 2 are the owners and possessors of the agriculture land admeasuring Ac.2.22 guntas each in SyNo.238/UU/3 and Sy.No.238/UU/2, CVBR, J Wp_25461_2024 respectively, situated at Medikunda Village, Wattipally Mandal, Sangareddy District.

The grievance of the petitioners is that respondent Nso.3 and 4, without initiating any proceedings under the provisions of the Act, 2013, have forcibly making efforts to dispossess the petitioners from the subject land, for the purpose of laying the road.

3. Learned Assistant Government Pleader appearing for the respondents would submit that the lands of the petitioners are not affecting for laying of the road and the writ petition is filed only prevent the respondents for initiating action in accordance with law.

4. In view of the above submissions, this Court, without going into the disputed questions whether the petitioners are pattadars of the subject land or the disputed road is laying through the patta lands of the petitioners, is of the opinion that the ends of justice would be met if the lands of the petitioners are in any affected for lying the road, the respondents are directed to follow the due procedure in accordance with law.
Accordingly, this Writ Petition is disposed of.
There shall be no order as to costs.
6. As a sequel thereto, miscellaneous petitions, if any, pending shall stand closed.

Note: Furnish C.C.
